notes: A008749_first (A008749_mathlib.lean): for n >= 1, p(a(n+2)) = n + 4 and p(T) != n + 4 for every T < a(n+2), where p(T) = 2*ceil((T + sqrt(6T))/2) - T and a is defined by the recurrence whose g.f. is (1+x^6)/((1-x)(1-x^2)(1-x^3)) (A008749_gf). Key steps: p(T) = v iff v = T (mod 2) and (v-2)^2 < 6T <= v^2 (p_eq_iff); 6a(N) = N^2 + e(N mod 6), e = 12,5,8,9,8,5, and a(N) = N (mod 2) (six_a). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the Harary-Harborth theorem that the minimal polyiamond perimeter A067628(T) equals p(T) (checked against the b-file T <= 10000 and by brute force over all polyiamonds T <= 11 in certificate/check.py).

sources.cite: F. Harary, H. Harborth, Extremal animals, J. Combin. Inform. System Sci. 1 (1976) 1-8
W. C. Yang, R. R. Meyer, Maximal and minimal polyiamonds (UW-Madison 2002)
